text: 中际旭创成交额突破600亿再创最高纪录，较前3个交易日成交额显著放量，此前最高纪录为2026年7月30日的597亿，中际旭创A股现跌超5%。
text_en: Zhongji Innolight's turnover exceeded RMB 60 billion, setting a new record, significantly higher than the previous three trading days; the prior record was RMB 59.7 billion on July 30, 2026, and Zhongji Innolight's A-shares are currently down over 5%.
